name: qq-to-codex-app-server-relay
description: A Rust-first, fail-closed QQ relay for Codex app-server

scripts.build: pnpm schema:check && cargo build --workspace --locked --release && pnpm --filter @qq-codex/qq-adapter build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm schema:check && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && pnpm --dir apps/qq-adapter exec prettier --write . ../../README.md ../../SECURITY.md ../../CONTRIBUTING.md ../../CHANGELOG.md ../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md ../../docs ../../.github ../../package.json ../../manifest.json ../../pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.schema:generate: cargo run --locked -q -p relay-protocol --bin export-schema -- --out schemas/relay-wire.schema.json && pnpm --filter @qq-codex/qq-adapter generate:contract
scripts.schema:check: cargo run --locked -q -p relay-protocol --bin export-schema -- --check schemas/relay-wire.schema.json && pnpm --filter @qq-codex/qq-adapter generate:contract:check
